author: Posighdun
body:
In a bid to actually be ready for next tourney we're trying to actively scrim. We prefer scrimming on Avicus with Avicus maps but an external server is better than no scrim. 

If you want to scrim then just post the prefered time and day below, a few hours notice would be nice thanks. We don't really care about timezones.
